responsibility: This file implements GCC’s GIMPLE/CFG instrumentation for prime-path coverage. It converts a function’s control-flow graph into the generic graph form used by the prime-path enumerator, filters out unsupported abnormal and fake edges, computes prime paths with ENTRY/EXIT cleanup, derives per-edge and per-block bitmasks for path buckets, and inserts SSA/GIMPLE code plus optional atomic counter updates that record which prime paths were exercised into gcov coverage counters. Its responsibility is the executable lowering from CFG paths to concrete profiling instrumentation, distinct from the generic path-enumeration algorithms.
